commuter.name: Commuter
commuter.blurb: The everyday small car, at the level's own pace.

darkvan.name: Panel van
darkvan.blurb: The everyday van: bigger and heavier than a commuter.

van.name: Delivery van
van.blurb: A vintage delivery van in its one livery. Never evil.

bus.name: City bus
bus.blurb: Long, heavy and slower than the cars round it. Never evil.

tractor.name: Tractor
tractor.blurb: Slow traffic that sets off from the same spot every run.

police.name: Police car
police.blurb: Bump it, or use the shoulder while it is near: you are busted.

semi.name: 18-wheeler
semi.blurb: Keeps the kerb lane and runs fast; hit hard enough, it blows up.

cargotruck.name: Cargo truck
cargotruck.blurb: An 18-wheeler with its doors open and its load coming off.

f1.name: F1 Car
f1.blurb: What you and the grid race in: light, quick, nimble F1 cars.

gt.name: GT Car
gt.blurb: What you and the grid race in: tougher, heavier GT cars.

lmp.name: LMP Prototype
lmp.blurb: What you and the grid race in: tough prototypes that never spin.

boat.name: Cruiser
boat.blurb: A cruiser like your jetboat. It leaves a wake.

trawler.name: Trawler
trawler.blurb: A fishing trawler, big and slow.

dinghy.name: Dinghy
dinghy.blurb: A quick, light dinghy with an outboard. On the water only.

barge.name: Barge
barge.blurb: Long, wide, heavy and slow: slip round it. On the water only.

ferry.name: Ferry
ferry.blurb: Big and steady. On the water only.

pedalo.name: Pedal boat
pedalo.blurb: Hardly moving. On the water only.

binlorry.name: Bin lorry
binlorry.blurb: Pulls up where it is every few seconds, hazards on.

learner.name: Learner driver
learner.blurb: Hesitates: dabs of the brakes, drifting about its lane.

boyracer.name: Boy racer
boyracer.blurb: Fast, and it sits on your bumper.

caravan.name: Caravan
caravan.blurb: A car towing a caravan, which swings about behind it.

driveby.name: Drive-by car
driveby.blurb: Only ever evil, and out for trouble.

float.name: Parade float
float.blurb: A crawling flatbed under a tower of colour. Never evil, never spun.

jeep.name: Jeep
jeep.blurb: The lightest army vehicle: it loses a head-on with a bigger one.

apc.name: 8x8
apc.blurb: An armoured carrier: beats a jeep head-on, loses to a tank.

tank.name: Tank
tank.blurb: Wins every head-on. Only its health, or a mine, finishes it.

ambulance.name: Ambulance
ambulance.blurb: Only ever an emergency vehicle, siren going.

getaway.name: Getaway car
getaway.blurb: Flat out, with the law behind it.

interceptor.name: Police interceptor
interceptor.blurb: After the getaway car, siren going.
